product: Kirzner: a lightweight AI business operator
customer: Solo founders and small AI-native teams using existing agents
capabilities: Verified at the starting repository commit: product direction and manual handoff design only; there was no application. This bootstrap adds a local business loop, but customer demand is not verified.
objective: Identify a low-cost, evidence-backed way to ask potential users about manual agent handoff friction, after a founder reviews the preparation materials.
time_budget: One focused preparation session; actual outreach requires a later founder decision
channels: Product repository documentation and existing founder-owned channels; none used for outreach during this bootstrap
constraints: No prospect contact, publication, purchase, deployment, or invented acquisition metrics. Research and preparation only.

materials.title: Kirzner product direction at the starting commit
materials.evidence: The repository identifies solo founders/small AI-native teams, manual task briefs, explicit founder decisions, and separation between agent returns and business outcomes. It explicitly states design-stage status.

materials.title: Semon implemented capture and ordinary-read interfaces
materials.evidence: Semon documents cursor-aware Codex capture, separate trace storage, and ordinary occurrence-log reads. These are technical preparation evidence, not proof of customer demand.
